bib.title: Improved Baselines with Visual Instruction Tuning

question: Which design choices (connector, data mix, response-format prompts, resolution, LLM) make a LLaVA-style large multimodal model strongest and most data-efficient in a controlled setting?
hypothesis: Inferred: LLaVA's simple fully-connected connector plus academic-task VQA data with clear response-format prompts can match or beat resampler-based models trained on far more data.
contributions: First systematic controlled study of LMM design choices under the LLaVA framework
LLaVA-1.5: CLIP-ViT-L-336px, two-layer MLP connector, academic-task VQA data with response-format prompts; SoTA on 11 benchmarks with 1.2M public samples
LLaVA-1.5-HD: grid-split high-resolution encoding with a global-context image, no extra pretraining
Early exploration of data efficiency, hallucination vs resolution, compositional capabilities

method.summary: Starting from LLaVA, the authors swap the linear projector for a two-layer MLP, add academic VQA/OCR/region data with explicit response-format prompts, raise the encoder to CLIP-ViT-L-336px, add ShareGPT text and scale to 13B Vicuna-v1.5. Training is two stages: connector alignment pretraining on 558K image-text pairs, then full-LLM visual instruction tuning on a 665K mixture. LLaVA-1.5-HD splits images into 224px grids, encodes each and adds a downsampled global view.
method.task: visual instruction tuning of a large multimodal model; VQA and instruction-following evaluation

datasets.name: Pretraining image-text pairs (same as LLaVA)
datasets.source: Table 3 lists 558K pretrain samples; text calls it ~600K image-text pairs

datasets.name: Instruction mixture (Table 7)
datasets.size: 665K total: LLaVA 158K, ShareGPT 40K, VQAv2 83K, GQA 72K, OKVQA 9K, OCRVQA 80K, A-OKVQA 66K, TextCaps 22K, RefCOCO 48K, VG 86K
datasets.split: all splits concatenated, sampled with same probability
datasets.preprocessing: VQA pairs of one image merged into one conversation; ShareGPT filtered as in Vicuna, conversations over 2048 tokens truncated (~40K); A-OKVQA pairs augmented k times (k = choices); 80K sampled from OCRVQA; 10 annotations per VG image; RefCOCO conversations cut into segments of fewer than 10; each batch drawn from a single modality (25% faster, no effect on outcome)

datasets.name: Eval benchmarks
datasets.size: VQAv2, GQA, VizWiz (8,000 images), ScienceQA-IMG, TextVQA, POPE, MME-Perception, MMBench, MMBench-CN, SEED-Bench, LLaVA-Bench-in-the-Wild, MM-Vet
datasets.preprocessing: SEED-Bench video: middle frame sampled; POPE F1 on random, popular, adversarial splits

models.name: LLaVA-1.5 (7B and 13B)
models.architecture: CLIP-ViT-L-336px encoder, two-layer MLP connector, Vicuna LLM

models.name: LLaVA-1.5-HD
models.architecture: CLIP-ViT-L-14 (224) on 224px grids, merged feature map plus 224px global image, row-end tokens

other.grids: up to six grids (1x1..1x6, 2x2, 2x3 and transposes)

models.name: InstructBLIP, Qwen-VL(-Chat), BLIP-2, IDEFICS, Shikra, original LLaVA

training.epochs: 1 (pretrain), 1 (finetune; inferred from Table 9 row epoch = 1 spanning both columns)
training.compute: ~6 hours pretraining and ~20 hours instruction tuning (13B final model reported as ~1 day on one 8-A100 node)

other.trainable: pretrain stage: projector; finetune stage: whole LLM and projector (stated in text as 'optimizes the whole LLM')
other.lr_note: pretraining lr halved relative to original LLaVA because of the MLP projector
other.HD_training: no extra pretraining; visual instruction tuning directly on high-res images

metrics.name: POPE
metrics.definition: F1 on random, popular and adversarial COCO subsets

eval.protocol: single runs; GPT-4 judge for LLaVA-Bench and MM-Vet; no significance tests stated

availability.code: stated 'Code and model will be publicly available'; project page https://llava-vl.github.io

prompts.purpose: short answers (VQAv2, GQA, TextVQA, MME, POPE, VizWiz)
prompts.text: Answer the question using a single word or phrase.
Answer with the option's letter from the given choices directly.
When the provided information is insufficient, respond with 'Unanswerable'. Answer the question using a single word or phrase.
Provide a one-sentence caption for the provided image.
Provide a short description for this region.
Provide the bounding box coordinate of the region this sentence describes.

results.quote: the model still maintains more than 98% of the full dataset

results.claim: Hallucination in detailed descriptions drops significantly at 448px input; qualitative, no number.

limits: Uses all image patches (576 at 336px), prolonging each training iteration; resamplers did not converge as efficiently on comparable data
No multiple-image understanding (no such data, context length limit)
Limited problem solving in some domains; still hallucinates, not for critical use such as medical
GQA, VQAv2 and others marked * had training images/annotations seen in training, so those cells are not zero-shot
Single runs; no seeds or significance tests; ablation numbers for data efficiency and LLM choice shown only as relative-performance plots
Hallucination-vs-resolution claim has no reported metric
Text says 11 benchmarks in abstract/Fig 1 and 12 benchmarks in Sec 4.1/4.2

terms.definition: a single prompt clause appended to VQA questions that clearly indicates the output format, e.g. 'Answer the question using a single word or phrase.'
